title: 她放弃全球总裁：降级去管门店，四个月后管半个美国，值吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: You were basically running a division at Kimberly Clark. You go to Walmart, was that a promotion, or was that more of a step down?
segments.zh: 你之前在金佰利基本管理一个部门，去沃尔玛算是升职还是降职？

segments.en: It was actually quite a demotion. I was, my title was Global President when I left Kimberly Clark.
segments.zh: 其实是降职。我离开金佰利时是全球总裁。

segments.en: And I knew I wanted to create a new skill set. So when I joined Walmart, I took a vice president's role in operations running the stores in the state of Georgia.
segments.zh: 我知道自己想学新技能，所以加入沃尔玛时，我担任副总裁，负责佐治亚州的门店运营。

segments.en: And it was tough work. I had to learn retail, but I was actually with one of the best retailers in the world.
segments.zh: 工作很辛苦，我得学零售，但我也和全球最好的零售商之一共事。

segments.en: And I was in this role for about four months, and I took over the Southeast operations, and then over a short period of time, I ran half the country for Walmart stores.
segments.zh: 我做了大约四个月，然后接管了东南部业务，不久后，我负责了沃尔玛美国一半的店铺。

segments.en: For people out there who are looking at their careers, and they are looking at new opportunities, what does it mean to maybe take that step down
segments.zh: 对于那些正在考虑职业发展、寻找新机会的人，降职可能意味着什么？

segments.en: with the idea that maybe that leads to a step up in the future?
segments.zh: 也许这能为未来的晋升铺路？

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, I think you have to constantly look at your skill sets and the deficits.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为你必须不断审视自己的技能和不足。

segments.en: And some individuals don't want to recognize that they're still learning to be had, that you're not as good as you think you are,
segments.zh: 有些人不想承认自己还有待学习，你并没有自己想的那么好。

segments.en: and you do need to expand. And I looked at myself and said, you're not growing anymore.
segments.zh: 你需要拓展。我审视自己，说：你不再成长了。

segments.en: And I had set across the table from Walmart and my role at Kimberly Clark supplying them diaper materials and finished product, and I admired retail.
segments.zh: 我曾与沃尔玛隔桌而坐，在金佰利公司负责供应尿布材料和成品，我钦佩零售业。
